properties.name: NUO Hotel Beijing
properties.fits_9: Three ~65sqm deluxe rooms incl. connecting pairs; indoor pool for the kids, Ming-inspired design for the grandparents.
properties.accessibility: Step-free entrance, large elevators, accessible rooms on request — easy scooter terrain.

properties.name: Ascott Raffles City Beijing
properties.fits_9: Three-Bedroom Premier: 263sqm, sleeps 8 + free infant cot for Aliya — whole family under one roof with kitchen and laundry.
properties.accessibility: Elevator tower, step-free lobby, one-level apartment interiors; mall + grocery in the same complex.

properties.name: Hotel Eclat Beijing
properties.fits_9: Three large suites (some with private plunge pools), Dali artworks for the teens — all inside a climate-controlled glass pyramid, a gift in freezing Beijing Dec-Feb.
properties.accessibility: Entirely indoor complex, elevators, level floors — scooter rolls from room to restaurants without going outside.

properties.name: Rosewood Beijing
properties.fits_9: Two connecting Premier rooms + Grand Studio; dedicated Family Staycation offer, indoor pool, babysitting.
properties.accessibility: Flat entry, spacious elevators, accessible rooms, wide corridors — scooter-friendly.

properties.name: The Peninsula Beijing
properties.fits_9: 24 sets of connecting rooms — most in Beijing's luxury tier; Wangfujing 2BR Suite + connecting Deluxe; free extra beds under 12.
properties.accessibility: Step-free entrance, accessible rooms, large elevators; shortest transfer to the Forbidden City for Nana.

properties.name: Toy Story Hotel (Disney Resort)
properties.fits_9: Three standard rooms (2 queens each) on the same floor; free park shuttle, lobby character moments, earliest-entry perk. Extra-guest fee RMB299/pp/night beyond 2+2 per room.
properties.accessibility: Purpose-built accessible: level entrances, elevators, accessible rooms, ramped shuttle boarding.

properties.name: Ascott Huai Hai Road Shanghai
properties.fits_9: 3BR Premier (228sqm) for two couples + kids, plus a Studio Executive for the third couple; kitchens + laundry are gold with a toddler; Xintiandi at the door.
properties.accessibility: High-rise with elevators, step-free entry; flat modern Xintiandi blocks are easy scooter terrain.

properties.name: Kerry Hotel Pudong
properties.fits_9: Two Questers Family Rooms (themed bunk areas) + one Deluxe; 700sqm indoor Adventure Zone playground — the best winter kids facility in Shanghai.
properties.accessibility: Step-free entry, accessible rooms, elevators; connected to Kerry Parkside mall — whole days can stay indoors.

properties.name: Shanghai Disneyland Hotel
properties.fits_9: Two-three Deluxe rooms; Magic-Kingdom-style hotel, character dining at Lumiere's, boat transfer to the park gate — Aliya and Naeema's dream.
properties.accessibility: Fully accessible: ramped boat dock, elevators, accessible rooms, roll-in showers on request.

properties.name: Fairmont Peace Hotel
properties.fits_9: Three rooms (adjacent on request) in the 1929 art-deco Bund landmark; the jazz bar is the grandparents' memory-maker, the Bund is Amirah's.
properties.accessibility: Heritage building retrofitted: level side entrance, elevators to all floors, accessible room category.

properties.name: Jing An Shangri-La
properties.fits_9: Official connecting suite + room combos plus a third room; Horizon Club lounge feeds the whole crew at breakfast.
properties.accessibility: Step-free entry, indoor link to mall and Metro with elevators — the most scooter-convenient premium base in Puxi.

activities.name: Mutianyu Great Wall — cable car up, toboggan down
activities.ages: All ages via enclosed cable car; toboggan: Naeema rides with an adult, Amirah solo, not for Aliya. Passport booking up to 30 days ahead
activities.accessibility: Scooter can board the enclosed gondola with staff assist; steep ~80m ramp at top, access to Tower 14 platform — the wall itself is stepped. Nana rides up for the view

activities.name: Forbidden City (Palace Museum)
activities.ages: All ages; book 7 days ahead with passports — sells out. Under 6 free
activities.accessibility: Free wheelchairs at Meridian Gate + marked barrier-free route with ramps; disabled visitor + 1 companion free

activities.name: Beijing Zoo — Giant Panda House
activities.ages: Perfect for Aliya and Naeema; pandas most active in cold weather. Under 6 free, seniors free
activities.accessibility: Flat paved paths, ramped panda house — the easiest accessibility win in Beijing

activities.name: Temple of Heaven
activities.ages: All ages; morning tai-chi and diabolo performers entertain kids free
activities.accessibility: Smooth scooter-friendly park paths; free wheelchair loan at East Gate; main halls visible from level plazas

activities.name: Shanghai Disneyland — 1-day ticket
activities.ages: All ages; under 1.0m free. Dec tiers $66 weekday / $84 regular / $100 weekend; CNY peak $112+
activities.accessibility: Disability Access Service (DAS) return times instead of queues; wheelchair/ECV rentals; attractions split roll-on vs transfer

activities.name: Shanghai Tower — Top of Shanghai, Floor 118
activities.ages: All ages; world's fastest elevators (55s to 546m) are the teen attraction themselves
activities.accessibility: Fully step-free street level to 118F — ideal scooter outing

activities.name: Huangpu River night cruise (~50 min)
activities.ages: All ages; skyline lights are the family highlight — wrap Aliya up for the open deck
activities.accessibility: Ramped gangways + enclosed accessible lower decks; gangway gradient varies with tide — call ahead for scooter boarding

activities.name: Yu Garden (Yuyuan)
activities.ages: All ages; Aliya in a carrier beats a stroller inside. Closed Mondays
activities.accessibility: CAUTION: stone thresholds, steps, narrow zig-zag bridges — largely NOT scooter-passable. Nana enjoys the level Yuyuan Bazaar lanes outside

notes: VISA: US citizens need the L tourist visa for a round-trip China holiday — 10-year multiple-entry, flat $140 (reduced fee through Dec 31 2026), all 9 travelers including the baby. The 240-hour visa-free transit only works if arriving from one country and departing to a DIFFERENT one (e.g., US→Shanghai→Tokyo). CHINESE NEW YEAR: CNY 2027 = Feb 6; the surge runs ~Jan 25–Feb 15 — hotel rates 2-3x, Disneyland Peak+/Peak++, trains sell out. Best value + empty Great Wall: early Dec–mid Jan (Beijing -10°C to 2°C — pack serious layers). Airbnb exited mainland China — apartments book via Trip.com or brand sites. Forbidden City releases tickets 7 days out and sells out; most sights use real-name passport booking.
